signed_rows.behavior: kmctl schema with no name lists every document kind with what it is for; an unknown kind is refused with that list.
signed_rows.fails_when: the list lacks any of decision, practice, proposal, prototype, handoff, manifesto, index, section-index, log, architecture, tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation, docs-index; or an unknown kind exits 0 or does not list the kinds

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl schema KIND prints valid JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) whose properties are fields from ALLOWED_FIELDS only, each with a description; kinds with no front matter allow no properties (the root index only okf_version); the body is described in x-kmctl-sections as a section list, a heading pattern, or none.
signed_rows.fails_when: for any kind the output is not valid draft 2020-12 JSON Schema, names a property not in ALLOWED_FIELDS or without a description, a no-front-matter kind allows a property, or x-kmctl-sections is missing

signed_rows.behavior: Everything kmctl init, kmctl new (each kind; with --stale-after for every kind and --source for every kind but handoff) and kmctl new doc (each type) writes matches its kind's schema, and this repository's own architecture page matches the architecture schema.
signed_rows.fails_when: any file those verbs write, or .okf/architecture/overview.md, fails its kind's schema: front matter does not validate, or its ## sections differ from a fixed list, come in another order, or do not match a heading pattern

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl schema's help says the schema is built from kmctl's own table and is what kmctl writes, without claiming kmctl check or the validator enforce it; the briefing names kmctl schema within its word budget.
signed_rows.fails_when: kmctl schema --help does not say the schema is built from kmctl's table and is what kmctl writes, or says kmctl check or the strict validator enforce it; the briefing does not name kmctl schema; or the briefing budget test fails
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_schema.py -k documented tests/test_briefing.py -q

signed_rows.behavior: The per-kind table in src/kmctl/kinds.py is the one definition the writers and the schema read: skeletons, the manifesto's sections, status values and the architecture kind.
signed_rows.fails_when: SKELETONS, the manifesto's section list, the status values or the architecture type and Depicts section are defined anywhere else in src/kmctl, or concepts.py, docs.py or scaffold.py does not import them from kinds.py

resigns.reason: plan round 1 review: one per-kind table in src, honest no-front-matter schemas, log pattern, help claims only what kmctl writes, no --source on handoffs
